About Plane | Work infrastructure for humans and agents
GitHub - makeplane/plane: Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.

name: Plane
summary: Open-source, AI-native project management workspace: work items, cycles, wiki, dashboards and agents.
description: Project management for teams and agents — work items, cycles, modules, wiki pages, intake, approvals, analytics dashboards and Plane AI (Pi Chat plus background agents). Runs on cloud, self-hosted or air-gapped; open source under AGPL-3.0 with GitHub, GitLab and Slack integrations, APIs and SDKs.
contains: views: board, spreadsheet, list, gantt, calendar
work items, cycles, modules, epics and initiatives
wiki with nested pages, intake forms, workflows and approvals
Plane AI: Pi Chat and background agents
free up to 12 users; Pro $6/user/mo annual; Business $13/user/mo
